name: chrome-extension-builder
description: Plan, research, design, build, test, and package Chrome Manifest V3 extensions with native specialist skills and an optional local Studio.

interface.longDescription: Build Manifest V3 Chrome extensions with 19 skills for research, architecture, UI/UX, frontend, backend, integrations, security, testing, performance, release preparation and maintenance. Designed for OpenAI plugin hosts with native skill metadata and 12 specialist role contracts. Guided chat workflows work without local tools; optional local Studio and scaffold/check/package helpers require supported host execution. Independent plugin by Khadin Akbar, intended for adult developers. No MCP, account service, purchases, credential intake or automatic startup. Generated products and store acceptance require separate verification.
defaultPrompt: Build a polished Chrome extension from my idea using the specialist team.
Open Extension Studio and help me choose an architecture and design.
Audit my extension and prepare a tested release package.

review.commerce_description: No plugin purchases, subscription, checkout or upsell. Generated extension products are separate.

publication.release_notes: Version 2.2.4 keeps Claude, Codex/OpenAI and Cursor native editions in one repository with matching documentation, policies and specialist contracts, adds an independent for Chrome compatibility logo, and uses verified direct public policy URLs. All 19 skills and optional manually invoked local tools remain; no MCP or automatic startup.
